ValidationRule.description: Restrict 'Priority' field update because the customer's profile was flagged for Extra Care
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( !ISNEW(), $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Customer_Complaint', NOT(ISBLANK(AccountId)), NOT(OR(ISPICKVAL(Account.ExtraCareTimePeriod__c,'Not required'),ISBLANK(TEXT(Account.ExtraCareTimePeriod__c)))), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Priority),'Vulnerable Customer'), ISPICKVAL(Priority,'Standard') )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The customer profile has been flagged for Extra Care. The 'Priority' field must be set to 'Customer experiencing vulnerability".
